coverage: Official generic server scenarios satisfiable by a stateless read-only server on the 2025-era protocol. Not a certification and not a full protocol audit.
exclusions: tools-call-* fixtures expect the SDK example tool set, which this server does not publish. Our own envelope contract is covered by scripts/smoke_mcp.py and tests/test_contract_conformance.py.
resources-read-* and prompts-get-* fixtures expect the example URIs and prompt names; application paths are covered by smoke_mcp.py.
Sessions, subscriptions, sampling, elicitation and OAuth are optional capabilities this stateless read-only server does not advertise.
